findings.wentWrong: Correct points but sides drawn too straight; marks only for the points.
Curves too straight between max and min; too few values marked - the x-axis needs -90, 0, 90, 180, 270, 360 and the y-axis +1 and -1.
findings.rule: Mark the key angles and the values plus and minus 1.

findings.wentWrong: No scales on the axes; some inverted the graph.
findings.rule: Sine starts at the origin going up; label the axes.

findings.wentWrong: The turning points at plus and minus 180 were not shown - sketches ran straight off below -1; the y-axis had no scale.
findings.rule: Cosine turns at plus or minus 180 with value -1.

findings.wentWrong: Asymptotes were omitted or placed at 180; curves touched or crossed them; the x-axis was unlabelled; some drew sine-like shapes.
findings.rule: Tan has asymptotes at 90 and 270; the curve approaches them but never touches.

ruleToRemember: Sketch a smooth curve with the key angles and plus or minus 1 marked; tan needs vertical asymptotes at 90 and 270 that the curve never touches.
